description: Translate text between about 100 languages with Meta's M2M100 1.2B model. Give the target language as an ISO code such as en, sv, de, fr, es, zh or ja; the source language is optional. Use to localise messages and documents. Example: text=Payment received, thank you!, to=sv, from=en. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: ai_translate
title: Translate text (100 languages)
